semiconductor_relevance: Low — Resquant focuses on Post-Quantum Cryptography solutions, which are not directly related to semiconductor manufacturing or supply.
summary: Resquant is a company specializing in Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) solutions, aimed at protecting digital data from future quantum computing threats. Their work is crucial for organizations needing to comply with emerging PQC standards, particularly those mandated by government and international agencies.
capabilities: Solutions for safeguarding digital data integrity against quantum threats
